## Security Checklist
Before asking for a review, please ensure:
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or hardcoded passwords have been introduced.
- [ ] Local `pre-commit` hooks passed successfully (`uv run pre-commit run --all-files`).
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) were added using `uv add` and are strictly necessary.
- [ ] Input data from users/APIs is properly validated (if applicable).
